text:
emma: Quick sync — we need a compact, partner-facing SEV path for EdgeScale (hardware partner) before tomorrow's joint runbook review. Goal: one page, clear who to ping, shared channel names, war room template, and phone escalation for SEV1.

raj: Proposed minimal flow: triage in shared channel -> escalate to Redwood eng oncall -> open war room + Zoom -> do cross-org postmortem. I can draft the contact tree.

jordan: +1. Add timing gates (5m, 15m, 45m) and a phone escalation step for SEV1s. Also include who owns the incident at each stage.

maria: CSM must be auto-looped at Stage 2. Marketplace PMs want a short notice template we can use for listings and customer comms.

liz: (EdgeScale) We prefer: single cross-org Slack war room, Zoom bridge, and our on-call SRE added. Our SRE handle is @liz.es. Also, can we avoid public status page updates until legal ok?

emma: Noted. Draft below — please review and edit. If we agree, I'll pin it to the shared channel and export to the partners runbook.

emma: ```
SEV ESCALATION SUMMARY — EdgeScale partner

SEV1 (total outage affecting production customers)
- Triage (0-5m): Post concise symptom in #partners-edgescale (public shared channel). Include error samples, region, and last good timestamp.
- Initial notify (5-15m): Ping @eng-oncall, @raj, and @jordan. CSM (@maria) auto-loop at 10m.
- Phone escalation (15m): Trigger PagerDuty SEV1 for Partner-Edgescale service and call on-call phone bridge. Use phone template: `+1-555-XXXX` (internal) or PagerDuty integration.
- War room (15-30m): Create private channel `#partners-edgescale-sev1-<ts>` using channel creation template. Invite: @liz.es, partner SRE, @emma, @raj, @jordan, @maria, @ops-bot. Start Zoom using Zoom template link.
- Owner (until handoff): Redwood eng-oncall acts as incident lead until senior eng takes over. Post decisions and mitigation steps in the war room.
- Customer comms: CSM drafts initial holding message using marketplace-safe template; legal to sign off before public status page post.
- Postmortem (within 72h): Joint postmortem owned by Redwood incident lead and EdgeScale SRE.

SEV2 (partial outage or degraded performance)
- Triage (0-15m): Discuss in #partners-edgescale. If not resolved in 45m escalate to eng-oncall and open `#partners-edgescale-sev2-<ts>` if cross-org coordination required.
- Owner: Partner SRE and Redwood triage engineer.

SEV3 (minor impact)
- Triage in channel, tracked in shared ticketing board, no war room.
```

raj: Small edits: change phone template line to include PagerDuty service key snippet and add alert thresholds.

jordan: Add one-liner for monitoring alerts to attach examples. Eg: `alert: edgescale_disk_io > 90% for 3m` and recommended runbook link.

emma: Good call. Added runbook and alert examples.

emma: ```
RUNBOOK LINKS:
- Partner runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partners/edgescale
- Alert examples to wire into partner PD: `edgescale_cpu_spike`, `edgescale_kvcache_evictions`

PagerDuty snippet to include in integration setup:
```
service: partner-edgescale
escalation_policy: SEV1-default
integration_key: <REDACTED>
```
Note: Use secrets manager for integration_key; do not paste keys in Slack.
```

ops-bot: Created channel #partners-edgescale and pinned a draft. If you want the per-incident war room auto-created, enable the partners-warroom-bot integration.

emma: Can someone volunteer to own the PD service and the automation to create `#partners-edgescale-sev1-<ts>` channels?

raj: I can own PD service config and the automation. I'll add runbook steps and test the flow this afternoon.

maria: I'll own customer comm templates and marketplace notice copy. Will wait on legal for public text.

liz: EdgeScale SRE confirmed — will join war rooms for SEV1/SEV2. We prefer Zoom over Google Meet.

deploy-bot: Zoom bridge template created: zoom.link/edgescale-template (auto-start when war room channel created) :white_check_mark:

emma: Thanks all. Plan: raj to test automation, maria to draft comms, I'll finalize doc and pin. We'll do a 15m dry-run in #partners-edgescale tomorrow 10:30 PT.

jordan: I'll be on the dry-run and validate timings.

liz: Confirmed for 10:30 PT.

emma: Closing — I'll publish to runbook after dry-run and share the final one-pager with legal + partner marketing. :thumbsup:
